description: evidentia runtime enforcement — turns prose invariants into enforced behavior: (1) PreToolUse guard denies pipeworx-gateway tools outside the §2.6 domain allowlist + D1/D2 broken MCP tools with a redirect (least-privilege / G-WHITELIST + broken-tool avoidance; D6 icd11_search retired 2026-08-17); (2) PreToolUse DENIES unscoped anamnesis hybrid/graph/global search and ALLOWS collection=evidentia:run:<run_id> (and/or evrun:<run_id>: prefix) scoped hybrid/search/graph — shared-corpus leak class; (3) PostToolUse reminds retrieve-don't-dump on large full-text output (evidence_index) and ledgers anamnesis ingest ids; (4) SessionStart preflight flags gated-connector problems, deriving the key map from fleet.lock.json (never hardcoded) and consulting the 24h-cached live fleet probe so a CONFIGURATION FAULT (401/403) is never mistaken for a legitimate key-absent degrade — silent when the fleet is healthy; (5) SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit mint an exclusive Anamnesis run collection+prefix; SessionEnd prefers forget_collection (fallback ledger forget_document). No Stop-hook forget. All command hooks are deterministic and fail-open. Disable the guard with <project>/.claude/evidentia-guard.off; run the preflight offline with EVIDENTIA_PREFLIGHT_NO_PROBE=1; stub forget with EVIDENTIA_ANAMNESIS_FORGET_LOG (CI).

hooks.statusMessage: evidentia: kanıt filosu preflight (kapılı connector + canlı prob)
